records.name: Monstro’s Belly Brawl
records.instructions: Enter Monstro’s Room of Truth for the story Shadow battle. Defeat Heartless quickly to fill the meter. If it empties, leave and re-enter the Room of Truth to retry.
records.replayVerification: PS2 firsthand guide section D.2.6 explicitly reports no additional prizes after first clear and Challenge Mode; Monstro cannot be replayed after clearing. Steam-specific repetition has not been independently established.

replayLineage.behavior: Room closes after the first successful clear; retry failed attempts beforehand.

records.instructions: At the Hunny Tree, approach the balloons tied to the log. Reach the top while avoiding branches and bees; losing every balloon ends the attempt. First clear: Firaga Burst. Second clear: Stop 0.

records.instructions: At Muddy Road, jump onto the well with rising air. Collect honey while holding Pooh; use the reaction command to recover him after a collision. First clear: Mega-Ether 5. Second clear: Gravity 9.

records.instructions: At Muddy Road, approach the honey hole in the tree. Protect Pooh with the supplied Attack, Wind and Honey cards. First clear: Elixir 1 after the 50-bee objective. Second clear: Hi-Potion 7. The achievement uses the 70-bee replay.

records.name: Veggie Panic
records.instructions: Talk to Rabbit after the Rabbit’s House scene. Send cabbages left and pumpkins right; use Strike Raid on large pumpkins or to protect Pooh. The initial clear requires 30 vegetables. First clear: Cross-slash+. Second clear: Fire 8.
